Senior Marketing Manager – Technical SEO, Growth & Marketing Operations | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Marketing Manager / Head of Marketing Operations to lead and execute high-impact initiatives across Technical SEO, content, organic growth, digital marketing, and marketing operations.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role for someone who can combine strategic marketing thinking with strong execution. You’ll be responsible for driving organic growth, managing marketing systems and workflows, overseeing website and SEO initiatives, coordinating campaigns, and using AI to improve marketing speed and scalability.

This is not a role for someone who only delegates. The ideal candidate is comfortable developing strategy and personally driving execution in a fast-moving environment.

If you’re deeply experienced in SEO, technically comfortable with modern websites, and AI-first in how you approach marketing, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute marketing initiatives across multiple digital channels
  • Drive organic growth through SEO, content, and digital marketing
  • Identify new opportunities to increase traffic, visibility, engagement, and revenue
  • Coordinate ongoing marketing campaigns and priorities
  • Support revenue-focused marketing initiatives
  • Track performance and adjust strategies based on results

Technical SEO & Organic Growth

  • Lead Technical SEO strategy and execution
  • Conduct technical, on-page, and content SEO audits
  • Identify and resolve issues affecting crawling, indexing, site architecture, and organic performance
  • Develop and execute backlink and authority-building strategies
  • Conduct keyword, competitor, and search opportunity research
  • Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and SEO performance
  • Stay current with evolving SEO, AIO, and AI-driven search strategies
  • Translate SEO insights into clear execution priorities

Website Management & Optimization

  • Manage website projects using ASTRO, headless WordPress, or similar CMS technologies
  • Coordinate website updates, landing pages, and optimization initiatives
  • Work closely with developers and designers on implementation
  • Maintain strong site performance, usability, and SEO fundamentals
  • Identify opportunities to improve website conversion and organic visibility
  • Ensure website projects remain aligned with broader marketing objectives

Content & Social Media

  • Create and oversee consistent social content across Instagram, Facebook, and X (Twitter)
  • Manage production of blogs, articles, promotional materials, and other marketing content
  • Support PR and outreach initiatives
  • Develop content around SEO opportunities and broader marketing objectives
  • Collaborate with designers and developers on creative execution
  • Maintain consistent messaging, branding, and positioning across channels

Marketing Operations & Systems

  • Build and maintain efficient marketing workflows and operational processes
  • Coordinate marketing projects across internal teams and external partners
  • Maintain visibility into deadlines, ownership, and deliverables
  • Manage reporting systems and performance tracking
  • Support quarterly reporting and shareholder updates
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement improvements
  • Ensure campaigns and marketing projects move from planning to execution efficiently

AI & Marketing Automation

  • Use AI tools to accelerate content production, SEO research, analysis, and marketing execution
  • Build and improve AI-assisted marketing workflows
  • Identify repetitive tasks that can be automated or streamlined
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and practical marketing applications
  • Use AI to improve research, ideation, reporting, and operational efficiency
  • Help establish an AI-first approach across the marketing function

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Monitor marketing, SEO, website, and campaign performance
  • Analyze trends and identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain clear reporting for leadership
  • Support quarterly performance analysis and business updates
  • Translate marketing data into actionable recommendations
  • Ensure marketing activity remains connected to business and revenue outcomes

Crisis & Brand Management

  • Support crisis-response marketing initiatives when required
  • Coordinate time-sensitive communications across appropriate channels
  • Maintain professionalism and responsiveness during high-priority situations
  • Ensure brand messaging remains accurate and consistent during critical events

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Proven experience in a senior marketing, growth, SEO, or marketing operations role
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Technical SEO and organic growth
  • Experience conducting SEO audits and implementing optimization strategies
  • Experience with backlink analysis and SEO tools
  • Experience managing websites using ASTRO, WordPress, headless CMS, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Google Ads
  • Strong understanding of AI tools and their application to marketing workflows
  • Experience managing cross-functional marketing projects
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to independently develop and execute marketing initiatives
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Active involvement in the SEO or digital marketing community
  • Experience with HubSpot, Slack, Asana, or similar platforms
  • Experience in luxury, hospitality, lifestyle, or travel-related industries
  • Experience supporting crisis-response marketing
  • Familiarity with Revenue Operations and marketing analytics
  • Experience with AI-powered search optimization
  • Experience coordinating developers and designers on website initiatives

Tools & Tech

ASTRO | WordPress | Headless CMS | Google Ads | SEO & Backlink Analysis Tools | AI Tools | HubSpot | Asana | Slack | Marketing Analytics & Reporting Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine strategy with hands-on execution
  • You understand Technical SEO beyond basic keywords and content optimization
  • You’re comfortable working with websites, developers, and technical systems
  • You can manage multiple marketing initiatives without losing visibility
  • You proactively identify opportunities and solve problems
  • You use AI as a core part of your marketing workflow
  • You’re analytical but can translate data into practical action
  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You’re comfortable taking ownership without heavy oversight

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A typical day may include:

  • Reviewing organic traffic, rankings, and SEO performance
  • Identifying technical SEO opportunities or website issues
  • Coordinating content creation and campaign execution
  • Reviewing or publishing social media content
  • Managing website updates with design and development teams
  • Analyzing backlink and organic growth opportunities
  • Building or improving an AI-assisted marketing workflow
  • Reviewing marketing performance and reporting
  • Coordinating priorities across internal and external stakeholders
  • Identifying new opportunities to improve growth and operational efficiency

In short: you drive marketing execution, operational structure, technical SEO, and organic growth across the business.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Organic traffic and search visibility growth
  • Improvements in Technical SEO performance
  • Website performance and optimization improvements
  • Consistency and quality of content production
  • Growth in digital engagement and visibility
  • Effective campaign execution
  • Marketing workflow efficiency
  • Accurate and actionable performance reporting
  • Successful implementation of AI-driven marketing systems
  • Marketing contribution to broader business and revenue objectives

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across marketing, SEO, content, and operations
  • Direct impact on organic growth and digital visibility
  • Opportunity to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • Work closely with leadership, designers, developers, and external partners
  • Build and implement AI-first marketing workflows
  • Fully remote environment
  • Opportunity to grow further into Head of Marketing, Growth Lead, Marketing Operations Director, or Digital Marketing Director

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Final Interview with Leadership
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re a Senior Marketing Manager who combines deep Technical SEO expertise with hands-on digital marketing, strong operational execution, and an AI-first approach, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and take ownership of high-impact marketing initiatives that drive organic growth, improve digital performance, and build scalable marketing operations.

Position Summary:

Marketplace is looking for a correspondent. The ideal candidate has proven audio and video reporting abilities, and a passion for covering business and financial news in Marketplace’s explanatory and accessible style.

Marketplace is focused on engaging communities directly to create content that always informs, includes, and inspires. We achieve this by building trust and connection through journalism that is audience-centered, distinctive, useful, and emotionally resonant.

This means:

  • Developing a truly audience-first approach to reporting and production
  • Producing work that succeeds across platforms and formats
  • Increasing our video and visual storytelling capabilities
  • Collaborating more effectively across shows, platforms, and teams

A correspondent will cover daily stories and features on subjects from corporate news to consumer behavior, housing to the changing workforce, macroeconomic trends to financial markets.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between MPR and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”).

Expected Compensation Range: $106,371 - $127,645 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

  • Synthesize multiple strands of a story and produce under tight deadlines.
  • Deliver substantive reports quickly on varied subjects as shows need.
  • Consistently deliver stories with Marketplace’s writing style and pace.
  • Gather information, audio and video for reports and programs.

  • Strong oral and written skills with ability to deliver originality in writing.
  • Capacity to deliver quick turn-around reporting.
  • Experience producing audio, video and digital stories.
  • Ability to develop stories with multiple interviews, scene changes and strong knowledge of subject matter.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Radio reporting experience
  • Knowledge of specific industries
  • Digital production knowledge

Reporting to This Position: None

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.We are committed to hiring a breadth of diverse professionals and encourage members of diverse groups to apply.

raw.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

​​Granicus is looking for a high-impact pricing and packaging leader who can drive step-change improvements in monetization, responsible for owning and evolving pricing, packaging, and monetization models across the Granicus product portfolio. This role operates at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Finance, with direct exposure to executive leadership and the opportunity to shape how Granicus monetizes its products, particularly as we expand into AI-driven offerings. The candidate will be expected to combine data, market insight, and strong judgment to make high-conviction pricing decisions in ambiguous environments; implement enhancements and changes; and measure impact and effectiveness. You will engage with executives across the company and have measurable impact on ARR, expansion, and margins. Reporting directly to the Head of Corporate Strategy and Transformation, you will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the executive leadership team and cross-functional stakeholders. This position will have strong dotted line responsibilities to the CRO, CPO, and CFO.

​​

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • ​​Pricing & Packaging Strategy: Drive pricing and packaging strategy, including value metric definitions, packaging architecture, and pricing model evolution, with a focus on driving land-and-expand dynamics and long-term customer value growth.
  • ​AI Monetization: Play a key role in shaping and executing Granicus' AI monetization strategy, balancing value capture with cost-to-serve, for Granicus' high-growth GXA products.
  • ​End-to-End Pricing Leadership: Lead pricing changes end-to-end, including pricing migrations, SKU redesign, and change management across sales, operations, product, and customer success.
  • ​Value Metrics & Monetization Models: Identify and define the right value metrics and monetization approaches, such as seat-based, usage-based, and outcome-based models, especially as products evolve toward AI-driven capabilities.
  • ​Executive Communication: Deliver crisp communication of recommended solutions to senior leaders and provide regular executive updates.
  • ​Stakeholder Coordination: Drive implementation of recommendations, coordinating stakeholders across operations, sales, renewals, finance, marketing, and product.
  • ​Product & Finance Partnership: Partner with Product and Finance to align pricing with product roadmap, cost-to-serve, and long-term unit economics.
  • ​Pricing Committee Leadership: Spearhead Granicus' Pricing Committee processes, ensuring strategic alignment and efficiency.
  • ​Pricing Operationalization: Ensure pricing is operationalized effectively, including sales enablement, discounting frameworks, and CPQ alignment, so that pricing sticks in market.
  • ​Market Intelligence: Act as the company's internal expert on modern SaaS and AI monetization trends, bringing forward innovative approaches to pricing and packaging.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

7+ years of experience across pricing, product marketing, strategy, or related roles.

  • ​Experience owning major components of a pricing transformation.
  • ​Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and drive change in a matrixed environment.
  • ​Robust analytical and quantitative skills, as well as attention to detail.
  • ​Strong balance of analytical rigor and decisive judgment; able to make decisions without perfect data.
  • ​Demonstrated success in a high-pressure, dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • ​Strong understanding of SaaS business models and go-to-market.
  • ​Executive presence, relationship building, and strong decision-making skills.
  • ​Ability to build financial models, pricing analyses, and business cases to support decision-making.
  • ​Advanced Excel/modeling skills and strong storytelling ability.

​ Preferred Qualifications:

  • ​Experience with AI or consumption-based monetization models in a SaaS environment.
  • ​Familiarity with CPQ tools and pricing operations systems.
  • ​Experience in govtech, public sector, or mission-driven technology organizations.
  • ​MBA or equivalent advanced degree in finance, strategy, or a related field.

​​

raw.title: Italian-speaking Technical Customer Support for Mercedes-Benz in Greece
raw.excerpt: What if your next career move came with a Greek address?
raw.description:
What if your next career move came with a Greek address?

Take your customer service career somewhere new and join Mercedes-Benz, one of the world's most recognised premium automotive brands.

As a Italian-speaking Technical Customer Support Specialist, you'll work remotely from Greece, gain international experience and develop valuable skills in technical support, automotive technology and customer experience.

And the best part? You don't need previous technical support experience. With full training provided, this is a great opportunity to get your foot in the door of the tech support world and build skills that can take your career further.


Your Role

You'll support Italian-speaking Mercedes-Benz customers with questions about their vehicles, features and connected services.

You'll:

  • Help customers understand vehicle features and services
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support
  • Handle enquiries via phone, email and chat
  • Explain solutions clearly and professionally
  • Deliver the premium customer experience Mercedes-Benz is known for

No technical background required — you'll be trained from the ground up.

Work Remotely From Greece

Once you've relocated and completed your training, you can work 100% remotely from anywhere in Greece.

Your relocation starts in Athens or Thessaloniki, where you'll receive support getting settled. Once you're established, you can choose where you'd like to live — from a lively city to a smaller town or somewhere closer to the coast.

And you'll receive all the equipment you need to work from home.

Full Relocation Support

Moving from Italy or another country? You'll receive:

  • Flight ticket to Greece
  • Airport pick-up
  • 2 weeks of free hotel accommodation upon arrival
  • Support finding long-term accommodation
  • Full remote-work equipment
  • Fully paid training
  • Free online Greek language courses

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Interest in cars, technology or technical support
  • Comfortable learning new systems and information
  • Willingness to relocate to Greece if currently living abroad
  • EU passport or valid Greek work permit

Benefits

What You Can Expect

The starting salary is €1,045 per month, with opportunities to develop your skills and progress within the company as you gain experience.

You'll also receive:

  • Private healthcare benefits
  • Employee discounts
  • Professional development opportunities
  • International and multicultural environment
  • Community events and social initiatives
  • Ongoing training and support


Living Costs in Greece

One of the biggest advantages of choosing Greece is that your salary can go further than in many Western European countries, particularly if you live outside the most expensive areas of Athens.

As a rough monthly example:

Approx. monthly cost:

  • Rent €400–500
  • Groceries €180–220
  • Utilities + internet €80–100
  • Transport + everyday expenses €100–150

Total €760–970

Choosing a smaller city, living outside the centre or sharing accommodation can reduce your monthly costs further — leaving more room for Greek food, beach days, weekend trips and enjoying your new life abroad.

And as you gain experience in technical support, your career opportunities can grow with you.


Your Greek Chapter Starts Here

This is more than a customer service job. It's a chance to put Mercedes-Benz on your CV, enter the technical support world without previous experience and build an international career.

Work remotely. Learn new skills. Explore Greece.

Your next career step could start in the Mediterranean.

raw.excerpt: PROJECT MANAGER | Relevate HealthWHO WE AREAt Relevate Health, we believe every HCP communication should be relevant, and we've built a company of exceptional people committed to making that vision a reality.
raw.description:
PROJECT MANAGER | Relevate Health

WHO WE ARE

At Relevate Health, we believe every HCP communication should be relevant, and we've built a company of exceptional people committed to making that vision a reality. We're healthcare marketing experts who push ourselves every single day to deliver life-changing engagement for the clients and patients who depend on us. Our culture is collaborative, growth-minded, and energized by purpose.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're growing our Creative team and looking for a sharp, strategic Group Copy Supervisor to join our expanding market access and health system practice. This role puts you at the intersection of science, strategy, and storytelling: leading copy across a portfolio of high-profile pharmaceutical accounts and driving creative that helps payers, health systems, and providers make informed decisions about today's most important therapies.

You'll own copy from brief through final delivery. You'll be the creative voice across PIE presentations, value proposition decks, patient and payer education materials, workshop decks, and more. You'll mentor and lead junior copywriters, collaborate daily with art, strategy, account, and medical teams, and show up with confidence and rationale in both internal and client-facing settings.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead and own copy development end-to-end across market access and health system materials, including PIE presentations, value proposition decks, leave-behinds, implementation guides, playbooks, case studies, objection handlers, training materials, infographics, and provider/patient/payer education materials
  • Manage, mentor, and supervise Junior Copywriters, Copywriters, and Senior Copywriters across day-to-day work and longer-term development
  • Collaborate closely with art, strategy, account, PM, and medical teams to ensure creative is on brief, on brand, and on time
  • Help develop and review project and creative briefs
  • Originate fresh, innovative concepts and transform them into effective copy across digital and print platforms, including websites, email, social media, and interactive digital tactics
  • Communicate complex medical and market access topics in a clean, concise, and medically accurate manner
  • Present work with confidence and thoughtful rationale. Clearly articulate copy decisions to internal teams and clients
  • Ensure editorial accuracy throughout the MLR process, including annotations and references
  • Participate in RFPs, pitches, and concept development
  • Connect with target audiences by applying insights from behavioral research, journey maps, and data
  • Proactively identify risks related to timing, process, or creative quality and come with a mitigation plan

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves:

  • Strong copywriting background with direct experience in market access and/or health system marketing at a market access agency
  • Ability to own a project from brief to final delivery and effectively direct others across large or multiple simultaneous projects
  • Demonstrated ability to consume, analyze, and translate complex medical and market access literature into compelling copy
  • Expertise in editorial accuracy, including MLR-compliant annotations and references
  • Conceptual thinking that pushes work beyond the expected
  • Confident, polished client presence. You know how to read the room and adjust in real time
  • Excellent listener who builds strong, trusted relationships across internal and client teams
  • Strong organizational and self-management skills with a clear sense of urgency
  • Ability to think quickly and adapt well in fast-paced, high-pressure situations
  • Self-aware. You know your strengths, own your gaps, and seek input when needed

Big Pluses:

  • Experience with Amgen, Sanofi, Regeneron, or similar large pharma accounts
  • Familiarity with ProofHQ or similar review platforms
  • Experience with LLM platforms integrated into a creative workflow
  • Comfort with health system strategy and payer/access landscape nuances

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree required, ideally in English, Journalism, or a related field
  • 4-7 years of copywriting experience
  • Minimum 3 years in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Minimum 3 years writing for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries

WHY RELEVATE?

We offer more than a job. We offer a place to grow, do meaningful work, and feel genuinely supported doing it.

Our Culture & Values

  • Be a part of a compassionate, driven team that emphasizes open communication through our PACT Core Values: Pioneering, Accountable, Caring, and Transparent.
  • We put our money where our values are. Every month, we recognize colleagues who go above and beyond to exemplify our PACT Core Values with a monetary bonus ranging from $500 to $2,500. At Relevate, living our values doesn't go unnoticed.
  • Be a Part of Our FUN!
    • Team Impact: Bringing our colleagues together to think outside the box and implement ingenious activities to involve, inspire, and facilitate positivity and caring.
    • Team HOPE: Seeks out philanthropic opportunities so that we can proactively care, respect, help, serve, and grow.Set Up for Success
  • A welcoming onboarding program with the focus on setting our new colleagues up for success from day one.
  • Competitive Pay & Top Benefits, Including:
    • Unlimited PTO
    • 401K
    • Pet Insurance
    • Health, Dental & Vision
    • Employer-paid STD, LTD, Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital, and Life Insurance
    • ...and more!

READY TO APPLY?

If you're a copywriter who thrives on ownership, loves a collaborative team, and wants to do work that actually matters in healthcare, we want to hear from you.

Relevate Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. raw.description:
About Edged Data Centers Edged is a fast-growing provider of sustainable data centers and energy infrastructure. The company builds and operates a global network of ultra-efficient, AI-ready data centers with waterless cooling for colocation, hyperscale and build-to-suit customers. The highly differentiated infrastructure platform is the first large-scale, global deployment of waterless cooling platform-wide and transforms data center growth into a catalyst for sustainable development. Edged is backed by a deep proprietary technology stack that will include renewable microgrid systems, ultra-clean generators, and waste-to-fuel solutions. The platform is designed for rapid deployment with more than a dozen new data centers operating or under construction across Europe and North America and a gigawatt-scale project pipeline. The North American division of Edged is a joint venture between one of the largest private multinational corporations in the world and an affiliate of Endeavour. Endeavour is a purpose-driven organization helping innovators to develop and launch breakthrough solutions for global challenges in the areas of energy, water, and waste. Endeavour companies are made up of passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. Today, Endeavour is deploying solutions that are immediately scalable and deliver both high financial returns and positive impact, including EV charging, waterless data center cooling, and advanced energy systems.

Learning Program Manager - Operations, Construction, and EHS

The Operations, Construction, and Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) Learning Program Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving training programs that support safe, consistent, and effective execution across data center operations, construction, commissioning, and environmental health and safety functions. This role partners closely with operational leaders, construction teams, EHS stakeholders, and site personnel to identify training needs, strengthen workforce capability, support regulatory and certification compliance, and ensure employees are prepared to perform critical work safely and effectively. The role also helps maintain the learning catalog, supports site-specific training needs, and uses data to evaluate training effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct regular gap analyses to identify opportunities for continuous program improvement

Utilize training effectiveness metrics to plan and implement program improvements.

Engage with stakeholders across the business to identify risks and determine how training can support mitigation of those risks.

Manage the existing training catalog by updating and retiring courses as needed.

Support operational Edged sites in the development of site-specific training materials.

Partner with Site Operations, Construction, and EHS to ensure certification compliance across regulatory-required training topics.

Partner with EHS team to ensure EHS training programs effectively support safe work practices across both operations and construction.

Ensure maximum value is derived from owner’s training at new sites.

Partner with Data Center Construction organization to develop programmatic support of Edged project management/delivery and commissioning functions.

Oversee the implementation of Data Center Technician qualification program.

Uphold training governance and ensure audit readiness by tracking and reporting on training completion.

Facilitates in-person delivery of training materials to support process adoption and skills development.

Skills

Understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design, and training program management.

Ability to translate complex technical, operational, construction, commissioning, and EHS topics into clear, practical learning materials.

Ability to partner effectively with site operations, construction, commissioning, EHS, and leadership teams.

Experience using training data, completion reports, assessments, and learner feedback to evaluate program effectiveness and drive improvement.

Effective project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple programs, priorities, timelines, and stakeholders.

Familiarity with Learning Management System (LMS) administration, training records management, certification tracking, and audit readiness practices.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate training and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or 5+ years relevant experience supporting training programs or working within a critical facility, data center, construction, commissioning, industrial operations, or EHS environment.

Experience developing or managing training programs in data centers, critical facilities, construction, commissioning, utilities, manufacturing, industrial operations, or a similarly technical environment.

Experience supporting compliance-driven training programs, technical qualification programs, or role-based learning paths.

Demonstrated ability to work with subject matter experts to develop accurate, scalable, and practical training content.

Experience coordinating cross-functional learning initiatives across multiple sites or business units.

Preferred experience with learning management systems, eLearning tools, instructor-led training, blended learning programs, and training governance processes.

Travel Requirements: Up to 25% travel required.

EEO Statement:

Edged is an equal opportunities employer. We believe in ensuring equal access to employment opportunities for all. We assess candidate qualifications and make recruiting decisions based on the experience, capabilities and skills you share with us in your application and applicable materials. Hiring and employment decisions within Edged are not based on religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Total Rewards Statement:

This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; PTO; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, location, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

Great Place to Work Enjoy…

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation.
  • A flexible, autonomous work environment.
  • A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.
  • Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.
  • Growth and travel opportunities.
  • A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet.

Job Description:

RMI is seeking a Total Rewards Senior Lead to own and lead its compensation, benefits, and people analytics function. Reporting to the Director of Talent & People Operations, you will own compensation strategy and administration, benefits program design and oversight, people analytics infrastructure, and LOA policy for a global workforce.

This is the senior Total Rewards presence at RMI. The function is being built and this person will serve as its architect; an experienced individual contributor with full functional accountability for compensation, benefits, LOA policy, and people analytics.

Responsibilities

Compensation Strategy & Administration

  • Own, lead, and evolve RMI’s global compensation strategy, including salary structure design, pay equity framework, job leveling, and the annual compensation cycle.

  • Maintain and evolve compensation benchmarking using market data (e.g., Radford, Mercer, Birches) to keep RMI competitive globally; lead new-hire and promotion benchmarking and the annual pay-equity review.

  • Partner with People Partners and hiring managers on offer recommendations and internal equity reviews.

  • Partner with People Operations on payroll accuracy and timing; serve as the Total Rewards SME on compensation-related payroll questions.

Benefits Strategy & Program Design

  • Own and lead benefits program strategy and design for US and global programs (health, dental, vision, retirement/403b, wellness, PTO, supplemental), with operational administration executed by the Benefits & Compliance Specialist.

  • Lead annual benefits plan assessment and plan design decisions — evaluating coverage, competitiveness, and global benefits structure; advise on renewals in partnership with People Operations, which maintains broker relationships and owns open enrollment execution in Workday.

  • Own and lead LOA policy design and oversight across all leave programs (FMLA, parental, disability, accommodations, sabbatical), with case management handled by the Benefits & Compliance Specialist; serve as policy SME for complex or escalated situations.

People Analytics

  • Own and lead compensation and benefits analytics, including pay equity reporting, salary trend analysis, benefits utilization data, and compensation benchmarking, to support decision-making across the People Team; partner with People Operations on broader People Team dashboards where compensation data is an input

  • Translate data into actionable insights and leadership presentations; partner with Finance on headcount modeling and workforce-planning scenarios.

Functional Leadership & Partnership

  • Own and lead the Total Rewards function end to end — setting strategy, standards, and priorities across compensation, benefits, LOA policy, and people analytics, and driving outcomes through cross-functional partnership rather than direct authority.

  • Partner with the Sr. Manager, Talent & Performance on analytics deliverables that support workforce planning, talent review, and performance management decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, or Benefits, with demonstrated ownership of compensation strategy, benefits program design, and people analytics.

  • Experience supporting a global workforce across multiple geographies and employment types (EOR, direct hire, contractors).

  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets and HRIS systems (Workday preferred), including experience building dashboards and analytics reporting using HRIS and compensation data.

  • Knowledge of US benefits compliance (ERISA, HIPAA, ACA) and familiarity with international benefits structures.

  • Experience with FMLA and state leave policy; comfort with LOA frameworks and third-party administrator management.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex compensation and benefits information to all levels.

  • Demonstrated ability to own a function independently and drive outcomes through influence rather than direct authority; experience partnering with specialists and analysts on execution while retaining full accountability for the work.

  • Experience building or maintaining compensation and benefits analytics, including pay equity reporting, salary benchmarking, and benefits utilization data, and translating insights into actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

  • Experience owning and leading compensation survey participation (Radford, Mercer, Birches, or comparable) and translating market data into pay recommendations and job architecture decisions.

  • Strong interpersonal awareness, collaboration, and coaching skills; skilled navigator of differences to build inclusive processes.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and build relationships at all levels in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) or CEBS (Certified Employee Benefits Specialist) certification is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with compensation survey platforms — Radford, Mercer, Birches, or comparable — including survey participation and market pricing methodology.

  • Experience with Workday compensation and benefits modules, including system configuration and reporting.

  • Experience owning and conducting pay equity analyses, including statistical review and remediation planning.

  • Experience with international compensation structures — EOR models, developing market pay practices, and multi-currency compensation management.

  • Experience with benefits open enrollment including plan design, employee communications, and coordination with system administration teams.

  • Experience with energy, climate, or mission-driven organizations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Finance, or related field.

We encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply, regardless of whether you feel you meet 100% of the qualifications. The top candidates will bring their own unique perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds from a variety of industries along with many but not necessarily all the skills listed above. We offer professional learning and training opportunities to help you develop the skills you may not have had the opportunity to cultivate yet.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note: At this time, RMI is not able to sponsor employment visas or hire candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the United States. All candidates must have current, independent authorization to work in the U.S. without present or future sponsorship from RMI. We will update our hiring pages if this status changes.

Location

We are a remote-ready company with team members around the globe. Our beautiful and welcoming offices are available for meetings or focused work, whether you are traveling through or living nearby. Our U.S. offices are in New York City; Washington DC; Oakland, California; Boulder, Colorado, and Basalt, Colorado. This role can be located from anywhere in the continental United States.

We provide you with the essential IT equipment plus a one-time home technology payment and a monthly work from home/commuter allowance to ensure you have a comfortable home office set up and necessary supplies.

We love seeing each other in person! We occasionally gather for shared time together like retreats and learning experiences. Be ready to travel for occasional in-person meetings (and of course, we cover travel costs). Some roles may require more travel, which will be discussed during the hiring process.

Compensation

At RMI, we prioritize fairness in our pay practices. Salaries are determined based on a mix of experience, market benchmarks, and internal equity across similar roles. The salary range for this position is $94,930-$117,000. New hires typically start toward the lower end of the range, depending on experience and alignment with the role scope. In addition to base salary, this position includes an annual bonus target of 10% and eligibility for merit-based increases, which are tied to both individual and organizational performance.

Benefits

We offer an array of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance

  • 403b retirement match with immediate vesting

  • Group life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability

  • Optional voluntary life, AD&D and accident plans

  • Health savings or flexible spending accounts

  • Fertility and hormonal health support

  • Mental health and wellness support

  • Comprehensive leaves of absence (including generous parental leave)

  • Generous paid time off and sick leave

  • Paid sabbatical leave

  • Regional holidays with at least one extended break in each geography

  • Work from home and home technology allowances

  • Learning & development opportunities (LinkedIn Learning and an annual individual professional development budget)

  • Potential for bonuses and merit increases

  • Discount marketplace (gym memberships, pet insurance, etc.)

  • Hybrid / remote work options

  • Team retreats and geographic meetups

  • Rewards and recognition programs

Diversity

We know that the diversity of our teams makes us stronger as an organization, and RMI is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity as outlined in U.S. federal law. We prohibit discrimination against applicants, interns, and employees on the basis of any legally recognized basis, including but not limited to: age (40 and over), race, color, sex, pregnancy (including lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), religion, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), sexual orientation, gender expression/identity, uniformed service member status, veteran status, citizenship status, or any other applicable status protected by applicable law.

RMI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Client Relationship Leader/Driver

  • Proven ability to work independently to understand client business objectives, success criteria, and value realization opportunities

  • Demonstrates deep understanding of customers' business processes, organizational culture, success challenges, and value drivers

Value Analysis/Solutions/Outcomes

  • Able to take client business objectives and turn them into comprehensive Value Realization programs -- including success metrics, measurement frameworks, and timeline milestones
  • Evaluate information gathered from multiple client sources, reconcile conflicting priorities, decompose high-level business goals into actionable value drivers, and abstract tactical activities into strategic value narratives
  • Proactively identify and communicate value realization opportunities and risks to client

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Ability to engage business sponsors and executive stakeholders to drive adoption and realize targeted business outcomes
  • Take and distribute meeting notes and value realization reports after all client interactions, and follow through on success plan execution
  • Grow client relationships in terms of value delivery, satisfaction, and long-term strategic partnership

Strategic Value Thinker

  • Serve as a Value Realization thought leader for assigned client engagements by implementing success frameworks and measurement capabilities that align with overall business strategy
  • Understand the client's business objectives and proactively manage client and consulting team expectations around value delivery timelines

Problem Solver & Success Advocate

  • Proven experience using structured, disciplined approaches to solving client adoption challenges, value measurement problems, and success barriers
  • Ability to head off potential client satisfaction issues before they materialize and have strong client advocacy skills

Documentation & Reporting

  • Strong skills to produce necessary Value Realization documentation, including success plans, value measurement frameworks, ROI reports, adoption metrics, and executive dashboards
  • Support the account team in developing value realization briefs, success statements of work, and measurement templates and tools

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6 years+ of Customer Success or Account Management experience in client-facing roles in consulting or agency settings
  • Experience with Value Realization methodologies, ROI measurement, or business outcome tracking
  • Conducting client workshops and stakeholder sessions to define success criteria and value metrics
  • Basic understanding of business case development and value measurement frameworks
  • Client relationship management and stakeholder engagement experience
  • Success plan development and execution
  • Understanding of consulting delivery methodologies and client engagement processes
  • Experience with customer success platforms (e.g., Gainsight) and measurement tools
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights

Preferred

  • Understanding of change management principles and adoption methodologies
  • Experience in client budget management and commercial discussions

raw.description:
Part of Amgen's R&D Strategy & Operations organization, the R&D Knowledge & Learning team serves staff across R&D and the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, transforming how we learn and grow together. We are reimagining learning as an integrated, longitudinal journey—inclusive of but not limited to traditional training—by deeply understanding roles, personas, and the competencies needed to deliver on our goals. Through our capabilities and expertise, which include learning & development, knowledge management, and the Amgen Library, we orchestrate tailored learning experiences that drive personal and organizational growth, empowering our teams to deliver on Amgen’s mission to serve patients around the world.

As the Learning Business Partner (LBP) for R&D/OCMO, you will act as a strategic partner to one or more sub-functions, working closely with VP-level senior leadership to understand business priorities, identify learning needs, and lead a team of learning professionals to co-create longitudinal learning strategies and plans that drive performance and innovation. Your team of learning professionals will orchestrate the design and delivery of learning interventions (inclusive of, but not limited to training), ensuring they are aligned to organizational goals with a focus on key roles and business transformation, and supporting learning across the employee lifecycle.

In this highly collaborative role, you will be the bridge between the R&D Knowledge & Learning organization, which includes our R&D Knowledge Management team and our Corporate Library capabilities, and one or more R&D/OCMO sub-functional leadership teams. You will embed yourself alongside your stakeholders to form a deep understanding their business as well as the needed competencies and knowledge, translating that into longitudinal learning experiences for key roles and driving the orchestration of a thoughtful and purposeful mix of learning interventions to achieve business results in a way that meets the learner where they are at. Your team will play a key role in managing the learning lifecycle from needs assessment through to execution and measurement, with an emphasis on aligning learning with strategic business outcomes.

We are hiring for 3 total positions. While all 3 roles share the same core purpose of shaping learning strategies and driving capability development, each role will support a unique set of sub-functional client groups in the R&D and Chief Medical Office organizations:

  • Research, Commercialization (CMZ), and R&D Strategy & Operations (RDSO)
  • Global Development
  • Global Medical, Global Regulatory Affairs & Strategy (GRAAS), and Global Patient Safety (GPS)

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary learning business partner for sub-functional leaders in R&D or OCMO, translating business priorities into longitudinal learning strategies that are inclusive of, but not limited to training.
  • Lead and work through a team to:
  • Orchestrate functionally specific onboarding experiences that integrate seamlessly with enterprise onboarding efforts, with a heavy touch on key roles, while establishing a consistent framework for broader use across the sub-function(s).
  • Conduct thorough learning needs assessments at the role and department-level to understand competency requirements, and drive decision making in collaboration with stakeholders to articulate skill gaps and development priorities for key roles in the organization.
  • Design and implement learning solutions across various modalities (live, virtual, self-serve, leveraging knowledge management capabilities where appropriate) that are tailored to specific roles and aligned with strategic priorities and transformation initiatives.
  • Partner with Amgen’s Quality organization and GxP Learning team to enable a vision for learning beyond read and certify, leveraging knowledge management techniques and other modern approaches.
  • Partner with internal and external content developers and trainers to curate and deliver high-quality learning experiences that drive individual and team performance.
  • Apply learning measurement frameworks to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs and implement improvements based on performance metrics.
  • Act as a change leader, ensure value realization of transformation initiatives by creating learning experiences that are inclusive of, but not limited to training, that foster the adoption of new processes, systems, and behaviors.
  • Ensure alignment of learning initiatives with enterprise-wide programs and collaborate across functions to share best practices and resources.
  • Manage stakeholder relationships and influence leadership to integrate learning into business planning and strategic decision-making processes.
  • Drive a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing, supporting initiatives that advance the development of defined competencies,contextualized application of leadership capabilities in alignment with enterprise frameworks, and drive overall workforce readiness for the jobs of today and the jobs of tomorrow.
  • Be an integrator within the R&D Knowledge and Learning team, orchestrating a thoughtful deployment of the full suite of capabilities from across knowledge management, the library, and our professional/core skills team while balancing and making trade-offs across the broader R&D/OCMO stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 4 years of related experience
  • OR Master’s degree and 8 years of related experience
  • OR Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of related experience

In addition to meeting one of these educational requirements, you must have at least 4 years of experience directly managing people and/or leading teams, projects, or programs, preferably in learning and development, training, or a related field.

Preferred Skills:

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic learning and development initiatives in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Track record of integrating various modalities of learning interventions.
  • Experience working closely with senior leadership at the executive director and vice president level to assess needs, design solutions, and drive business outcomes.
  • In-depth knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design, with experience delivering learning across multiple modalities (virtual, in-person, blended).
  • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence senior leaders.
  • Familiarity with learning measurement frameworks and the ability to analyze learning data and metrics to assess program effectiveness and inform future initiatives.
  • Experience in managing external vendors and working with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality learning solutions.
  • Knowledge and/or prior experience within one or more of the R&D and/or OCMO sub-functions, with a solid understanding of the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry and its regulatory landscape.

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan comprising health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities including:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns
  • Flexible work models, including remote work arrangements, where possible

Apply now

for a career that defies imagination

Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.

careers.amgen.com

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Investing App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

raw.description:
LawVu is the AI-native operating system for in-house legal - the foundational layer that powers the entire legal function. Our intelligent platform connects legal intake, matters, contracts, spend, and reporting in one connected workspace, enabling legal teams to work smarter, move faster, and deliver measurable business value.

Trusted by leading organizations including Discord, Employment Hero, Etsy, and many more, LawVu is helping legal teams transform from reactive service providers into strategic business partners.

Founded in New Zealand, LawVu is a fast-growing global software company with customers and employees across North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. Backed by leading venture capital firms, including Insight Partners and Airtree Ventures, we're creating a new category of LegalOS software purpose-built for modern in-house legal teams.

We are seeking a Legal Counsel to support commercial contracting, data/privacy matters, and legal operational processes across the business. The Legal Counsel is a key member of the legal team, driving timely and effective legal support for our global sales and customer-facing activities. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a dynamic, fast moving SaaS environment.

You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Security, Product and Finance teams to support contracting activity, help streamline legal processes, and contribute to building a mature legal function. You will enable fast, scalable, and compliant contracting that supports the company’s growth.

Candidates with SaaS, privacy, or legal operations experience - or a strong interest in developing in these areas - are strongly encouraged to apply.

Areas of Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead SaaS and Commercial Contracting

·Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts, including SaaS subscription agreements, MSAs, and DPAs.

·Assist with supplier and customer contracting, working under guidance from senior legal team members.

·Ensure agreements align with LawVu’s commercial objectives, product offering, and risk profile.

2. Evaluate risk within the business context

·Take end-to-end ownership of negotiations on enterprise-level customer contracts.

·Balance legal risk with commercial outcomes, proposing pragmatic options and trade-offs.

·Join customer calls and meetings to support Sales and Customer Success in landing key deals.

·Support developing and maintaining negotiation playbooks and fallback positions for key clauses

3. Provide IP, IT and Data/Privacy Expertise

·Advise on intellectual property ownership and licensing, including software, content, know-how and trade secrets.

·Provide guidance on privacy and data protection requirements in a SaaS context, including cross-border data transfers and data processing arrangements.

4. Draft Clear, Modern Templates and Policies

·Own and continuously improve customer-facing templates and online terms

·Draft in plain, modern language that is clear for both internal stakeholders and customers.

·Keep templates aligned with product roadmap, security posture, market practice and regulatory changes.

5. Embed a Commercial and Product Mindset

·Develop a deep understanding of our SaaS product and emerging technologies provisioned by LawVu

6. Operate Effectively in a Growth Environment

·Manage a high and varied workload, often under time pressure and with competing priorities.

·Work autonomously on day-to-day matters, while knowing when to seek input or escalate.

·Help refine and streamline ways of working so the legal team can support growth at scale.

7. Collaborate as a Trusted Business Partner

·Build strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Security, Finance and other stakeholders.

·Be seen as a problem-solver who helps the business get to “yes” safely, not a blocker.

·Provide concise, solution-oriented advice to non-lawyers, tailored to different audiences.

8. Strengthen Legal Processes, Judgement and Governance

·Exercise sound legal judgement and take clear ownership of issues from start to finish.

·Improve and maintain contracting processes and legal operations

·Contribute to broader legal and compliance initiatives, such as policy development, internal training and risk management.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

SVP, Commercial Sales

📍 Remote, US-Based

✈️ Travel: 20–25%

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

The difference you’ll make:

At Midi Health, we’re building the leading virtual care clinic for women navigating perimenopause, menopause, and other midlife health challenges—and we’re growing fast.

We’re onboarding approximately 1,000 new patients every day and conducting 30,000 virtual visits per week, while partnering with leading health plans, employers, and health systems to make comprehensive midlife care accessible at scale.

We’re looking for an SVP of Commercial Sales to lead the next phase of that growth. Reporting to our Chief Commercial Officer, you’ll own Midi’s payer and employer revenue engine across Health Plan Sales, Health Plan Alliances, Employer Sales, Client Success, and Sales Operations.

You’ll set the commercial strategy, build and lead the organization, and create the operating rigor required to turn Midi’s early traction into a repeatable, compounding growth engine. You’ll be accountable for covered lives, revenue growth and retention, pipeline predictability, and the caliber of the team you build.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the commercial sales organization. Hire, coach, and scale leaders across Health Plan Sales, Health Plan Alliances, Employer Sales, Client Success, and Sales Operations, building a high-performing team with clear ownership and accountability.
  • Own payer and employer GTM strategy. Set targets, priorities, budgets, and growth sequencing across health plans and employers—determining where Midi plays, how we win, and how we scale.
  • Build our alliance and channel engine. Define how Midi activates consultants, brokers, health plans, and strategic partners to expand access, generate demand, and accelerate growth.
  • Drive retention and expansion. Own the strategy for renewals, account growth, program adoption, and net revenue retention, including executive engagement with Midi’s most strategic partners.
  • Create commercial operating rigor. Establish the forecasting, pipeline management, systems, and operating cadence needed to accurately predict performance and hold the organization accountable to results.
  • Operate as a senior commercial leader. Translate performance, opportunities, and risks for the CCO, executive leadership, and board, while representing Midi externally with senior leaders across the healthcare ecosystem.

Who you are:

  • You bring 12+ years of progressive experience in payer and/or employer benefits sales, partnerships, or commercial leadership, ideally within high-growth healthcare, digital health, or value-based care.
  • You’ve built and scaled revenue organizations spanning multiple motions—including new business, alliances/channels, account management or Client Success, and Sales Operations—and have experience leading leaders.
  • You have a demonstrated track record of owning the number at meaningful scale, whether that’s revenue, covered lives, quota, net retention, or another core commercial metric.
  • You have deep experience selling into and partnering with health plans and/or large employers, navigating complex enterprise sales cycles and closing multi-million-dollar partnerships. Experience with Blues plans is strongly preferred.
  • You’ve helped build GTM organizations through both 0→1 and 1→100 stages, including hiring and developing the leaders and individual contributors required to scale.
  • You combine strategic range with operating discipline—equally comfortable setting the commercial strategy, reviewing the forecast, coaching a leader, or getting involved in a critical deal.
  • You build trust and influence with C-level stakeholders and can effectively represent the business with customers, partners, executives, and the board.
  • You thrive in high-growth environments: self-directed, resourceful, low-ego, and energized by building through ambiguity.
  • You’re passionate about improving healthcare for women and excited by Midi’s mission.

Why you’ll love working at Midi:

  • Build a category-defining company transforming how healthcare serves women in midlife.
  • Own a critical growth engine with meaningful influence over Midi’s commercial strategy and next stage of scale.
  • Join at a pivotal moment, with meaningful payer and employer traction and enormous opportunity ahead.
  • Share in the upside through competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
  • Work with a mission-driven, high-ownership team that moves quickly and cares deeply about the patients and partners we serve.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Google Ventures, Semper Virens, and Emerson Collective, trusted by leading health plans and employers, and growing rapidly to meet nationwide demand.

Our mission is simple: change the way healthcare serves women in midlife—because women deserve better.

The salary for this role is 260,000-340,000 annually. Final compensation will depend on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for additional compensation, including equity and benefits.

At this time, Midi is unable to provide visa sponsorship. All Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship needs.

Please note that all official communication from Midi Health will come from an @joinmidi.com email address. We will never ask for payment of any kind during the application or hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Midi Health, please report it immediately by emailing us at .

Midi Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to pay equity and ensure that all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Our compensation philosophy is based on fair, objective criteria and the impact of the role, regardless of an applicant’s salary history.

Our Organization and Mission:

The Florida Commission on Human Relations is the state agency charged with enforcing the state’s civil rights laws and serves as a resource on human relations for the people of Florida. It is against Florida law to discriminate on the bases of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, marital status or familial status. The Commission investigates complaints of discrimination in the areas of employment, housing, public accommodations, and state employee whistle-blower retaliation.

The Commission is responsible for promoting fair treatment, equal opportunity, and mutual respect among members of all economic, social, racial, religious and ethnic groups and works to eliminate discrimination against groups and their members.

The Work You Will Do:

This is an independent professional position as the Investigation Specialist I, conducting investigations about discrimination cases within the State of Florida. The incumbent will gather and record information accurately and thoroughly through interviews and or correspondence with parties involved in the investigation. This involves conducting research and collecting facts about any complaint assigned and the incumbent must be able to write investigative reports within the statutory timeframes. The incumbent will testify and appear before the Commission panels and in civil court proceedings, and administrative hearings regarding investigative findings and recommendations.

The Difference You Will Make:

In this position, you will serve a critical role in ensuring compliance with state and federal civil rights laws through the impartial investigation of discrimination complaints. Your work will support the Commission’s statutory responsibilities by conducting thorough fact-finding, analyzing evidence, and preparing comprehensive investigative reports within established timeframes. Through objective evaluation of allegations and supporting documentation, you will contribute to legally sound determinations and recommendations.

How You Will Grow:

The Florida Commission on Human Relations is committed to cultivating professional growth, leadership development, and continuous learning for its employees. Training and development opportunities are designed to enhance expertise and support long-term career advancement in public service.

Where You Will Work:

4075 Esplanade Way, Room 110, Tallahassee, FL 32399

This is a remote position.

Pay:

$42,000.00

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of basic investigations techniques, rules of evidence, court procedures and requirements.
  • Skilled in using logic and reasoning.
  • Skilled in utilizing techniques of active listening.
  • Ability to conduct fact-finding interviews and take statements.
  • Ability to use deductive reasoning.
  • Ability to analyze informed and determine its a validity.
  • Ability to write accurate investigation reports and present detailed verbal presentations.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Ability to make independent decisions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to establish and maintain a productive working relationship with others.

Qualifications:

Minimum:

  • Five years of experience in legal or paralegal work, investigative work, human relations, human resources, regulatory inspections, social work, personnel, education, counseling, affirmative action (AA), equal employment opportunity (EEO), or in working in the juvenile or adult criminal justice system.
  • A bachelor’s degree and one year of experience as described above.

Preferred:

  • Experience conducting fact-finding interviews with members of the public gathering information.
  • Experience writing detailed, analytical reports or analyses.
  • Experience dealing with and analyzing large amounts of documentation.

The Benefits of Working for the State of Florida:

Working for the State of Florida is more than a paycheck. The State’s total compensation package for employees features a highly competitive set of employee benefits including:

  • Annual and Sick Leave benefits;
  • Nine paid holidays and one Personal Holiday each year;
  • State Group Insurance coverage options, including health, life, dental, vision, and other supplemental insurance options;

For a more complete list of benefits, visit .
